Notched flute of reed with a closed end. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]

Notched flute of reed, open at the end. There are three finger-holes burnt into the reed in a vertical line. The upper half is bound with cotton fibre and a length of red textile. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]

Notched flute of reed, open at the end. There are three finger-holes burnt into the reed, four in a line and one to the side. The notched end of the flute is split, while the opposite end is bound with cotton string. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]
Flute. Made from a hollow length of reed and closed at both ends. There are two stops at each end, four in total. [AB [OPS Move] 2/2/2017]

Half of a nose flute, consisting of a tubular piece of reed, closed at one end. There are two stops near the closed end, which is coated in gum. The open end is narrow in order to slot into the reed that makes up the other half, [1964.2.105 .20 .1].

Half of a nose flute. Consisting of a tubular piece of reed, closed at one end. There are two stops near the closed end. The open end is narrow in order to slot into the reed that makes up the other half, [1964.2.105 .21 .1].
Section of duct flute. Made of reed. With one stop. Open at both ends, there is cotton tied around one end of the reed. For the major section of the flute see 1964.2.108 .1  [AB [OPS Move] 6/2/2017]

Reed for a clarinet. The reed is straight, one end is closed the other is sliced at an angle. There is a band of red coloured textile tied to the reed part-way along its length. For the clarinet please see 1964.2.99 .1  [AB [OPS Move] 17/2/2017]

Extension tube for single reed clarinet. Made from a hollow length of wood from the "congo pump" tree. It is cylindrical, one end is carved to taper slightly. For the clarinet see 1964.2.102 .1, for the reed see 1964.2.102 .3  [AB [OPS Move] 17/2/2017]
One of a pair of rattles. For the other in the pair please see 1964.2.72 .1 [AB [OPS Move] 6/2/2017]
Nose flute made from two tubular sections of reed, closed at both ends [.1-.2]. One piece [.1] has a binding of red textile at the open end. [AB [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]
Nose flute made from two tubular sections of reed, closed at both ends [1964.2.105 .19 .1 - .2]. [JMC 22/2/2019]
Notched flute of reed with a closed end. [JC [OPS Move] 31/1/2017]
Notched flute of reed with a closed end. There are six finger-holes burnt into the reed, four in a line and one to either side. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]

Notched flute of reed with a closed end. There are six finger-holes burnt into the reed, four in a line and two to one side near the closed end. The upper half of the flute is bound with very fine plant fibre. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]
Notched flute of reed, open at the end. There are three finger-holes burnt into the reed in a vertical line. The end is bound with cotton string to prevent further splitting. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]

Notched flute of reed, open at the end. There are three finger-holes burnt into the reed in a vertical line. The top of the flute is bound with fine plant fibre cord and a section below the finger holes is bound with cotton fibre. There is a small split which is coated in parts with gum and urucu dye, to prevent further splitting. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]
Notched flute of reed, open at the end. There are three finger-holes burnt into the reed in a vertical line. The end is bound with cotton string. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]

Notched flute made from a piece of plastic tubing, open at both ends. A perforated wax node is situated inside the flute. There are three finger-holes in a vertical line and a small area of string binding near the far end. [JC [OPS Move] 1/2/2017]

Half of a nose flute, consisting of a tubular piece of reed, closed at one end. There are two stops near the closed end, which is coated in gum. The open end has a binding of red textile. For the reed that makes up the other half see [1964.2.105 .20 .2].

Duct flute. Made from reed. One end of the reed is open, the other closed with a small perforation. There is a rectangular perforation in the body of the reed, within this is a nodule made of gum and black in colour. There is a strip of plant leaf wrapped around the flute and tied with plant fibre. [AB [OPS Move] 6/2/2017]

Single reed clarinet. Made from a hollow length of wood from the "congo pump" tree. It is cylindrical, one end is oblique, this end is split. Please note that there is no reed for this clarinet.  [AB [OPS Move] 17/2/2017]

Single reed clarinet. Made from a hollow length of wood from the "congo pump" tree. It is cylindrical, one end is notched. For the clarinet extension see 1964.2.102 .2, for the reed see 1964.2.102 .3  [AB [OPS Move] 17/2/2017]
Side-blown trumpet formed from a central reed attached to an armadillo claw and surrounded by two cones, one of palm leaf, one of split reed decorated with feathers. [JC [OPS Move] 2/2/2017]
